title: Grilled Chili Tofu Skewers with Ranch Cabbage, Apple & Cucumber Slaw

steps.text: Cut tofu in half along the long side. Sandwich tofu between clean towels or paper towels and place on a baking sheet pan. Place a cutting board with something heavy on top and set aside to press out excess water.
If using wooden skewers, place 8-12 skewers in a shallow dish of water to soak until you are ready to use them.
Large dice tofu, drizzle with oil, and season with spices. Thread onto skewers and place on a plate. (If you don't have skewers, you can cook the tofu directly on the grill pan.)
Preheat a grill pan, outdoor grill, or regular skillet over medium-high heat.
Once the pan is hot, working in batches if necessary, add the skewers and cook, turning occasionally, until the tofu is golden brown, 8-10 minutes. Return to the plate.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Trim and medium dice cucumber. Place in a large bowl.
Quarter, core, and medium dice apples. Add to the bowl with the cucumber.
Halve and pit avocados; using a spoon, scoop out the flesh and medium dice. Add to the bowl along with shredded cabbage and dressing, then stir to combine the slaw.
To serve, divide skewers and slaw between plates. Enjoy!
